❌ Legacy SDP DataChannel & SCTP Failure Modes (RFC 8864 / RFC 8841)
1. a=dcmap / a=dcsa Subprotocol Injection: Unchecked SDP subprotocol
strings route untrusted peers to internal admin RPC handlers in 0-RTT.
2. Pre-Negotiated Stream DCEP Collision: Sending in-band DCEP (PPID=50)
on an RFC 8864 pre-negotiated stream ID overwrites channel state.
3. a=max-message-size:0 Reassembly OOM Bomb: Setting size=0 (unlimited)
with endless E-bit=0 SCTP fragments exhausts worker RAM and drops calls.
Result: 0-RTT subprotocol RPC hijack + usrsctp reassembly OOM crash
✅ Deterministic P989–P990 🎉 dcmap Allowlist & Reassembly Gate
1. P989 (998th Guard) dcmap/dcsa Allowlist & DCEP Block: Enforce strict
subprotocol allowlist, drop PPID=50 on dcmap streams & cap channels ∈ [1, 8].
2. P990 🎉 (🎉 140th FAQ & 940th Test) [16, 256] KB Reassembly Ceiling:
Forbid a=max-message-size:0 & clamp SCTP reassembly within [16, 256] KB.
3. Zero-OOM Voice Isolation: Abort oversized unfinished SCTP fragments
in 0ms while keeping Opus audio and barge-in control channels intact.
Result: 0 subprotocol/DCEP collisions · 0 OOM bombs · size ∈ [16, 256] KB
